meta.prompt: Show the plan for migrating my blog as steps: six steps with a short description each. A start button runs them one after another (a second or two each) with a spinner on the running step, ticks on the finished ones, a progress bar and the time elapsed, a pause button, and a summary when all are done.
meta.text:
Card gap:12 pad:16
  Text.heading "Blog migration plan"
  state done=0
  state running=false
  state elapsed=0
  state steps=["Export posts from the old CMS","Map categories and tags","Move images to new storage","Rewrite internal links","Set up redirects for old URLs","Verify pages and publish"]
  every 1000 when running -> elapsed=elapsed+1
  every 1500 when running -> done=min(done+1,6); running=done+1<6
  Column gap:8
    each row in steps
      PlanStep "{row}" "" index:0 current:=done running:=running
  ProgressLine "Progress" "{elapsed} s elapsed" value:=done/6
  if done<6
    Row gap:10
      ActionButton "Start" tone:primary -> running=true
      ActionButton "Pause" tone:quiet -> running=false
  if done==6
    Callout "Migration complete" "All six steps finished in {elapsed} s. Your blog is live on the new platform." tone:good icon:check

delta: Your blog is live on the new
